title: The Synth tab: Poly, Mono and Acid
thisBuild: A new tab, SYNTH, right after PLAY. A synth sits on a pad like a sound, so steps, Roll, keys, Hold and Repeat all play it.

Open SYNTH with an empty pad free and tap On empty pad, or put one on the selected pad instead of its sound. Start from 11 presets: Warm pad, Soft keys, Brass, Chord stab, Mono bass, Acid line, Square acid, Sync lead, Wobble, Glass bell, Noise sweep.

Three views. Simple: the knobs that matter most and a keyboard. Full: every knob, grouped (two oscillators, mixer, filter, two envelopes, LFO, voice). Synthipad: the page becomes a playing surface, four rows of in-key notes with an XY square for the filter (across is cutoff, up is resonance).
Knobs: drag up or right to turn up, double tap for the default, hold to type a value. Turning a knob changes notes already playing.

Poly plays chords. Mono plays one note and glides between held keys (let go of the top key and it slides back). Acid is mono with a squelchy filter: in Roll, notes that touch slide into each other, and fresh notes get an accent.
On a synth pad, the pad menu and the button by the bank numbers say Synth and open this tab.
From build 62: Bake, and the Latency screen in Notes for Claude.
watch: Make a Warm pad and hold a chord on the keyboard, then turn Cutoff while it sounds.
Make an Acid line, draw a few notes in Roll with some touching, and play the loop: touching notes should slide.
Try Mono bass on steps, and Synthipad with two or three fingers.
Watch the Latency screen's load with a big Warm pad chord: unison pads cost the most.
limits: Only the Analog synth so far. FM, wavetable, granular, drums and plucks come next, each as its own build.
A synth is mono out of its voice (pan and the effects still apply); no stereo unison spread yet.
Notes in Roll have no per-note accent or velocity yet; Acid's accent goes on every fresh note.
Synths are saved in the mess file. The website's Mess Machine does not know them yet, so a mess with a synth opens there without it.
